name: Five Nights at Leon’s 4
summary: Before the horrible bombing of Leon's pizza place there was an accident that occurred before the blast. I heard that Leon killed a child. There was kid who loved Leon and his friends so much but when he saw Leon killing the child he started to see things that are not real he started to have nightmares about them. Now Golden Leon is helping the kid to defeat his nightmares by remembering what exactly happened during the incident day.
